Title: Everything about AMP: From the Beginning to the Strongest Line-up | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/us/news/everything-about-amp-beginning-strongest-line
Published: 2019-06-17T09:13:22.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Later, ZOTAC GeForce GTX 900 Series AMP took performance to the next level with new features like Carbon ExoArmor and EKO fans. When our gaming brand, ZOTAC GAMING, launched its first GeForce RTX graphics card in 2018, we revamped SPECTRA to create more powerful lighting effects for the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080/2080 Ti AMP Extreme and AMP Extreme Core Graphics Cards.

...

FOUR LEVELS OF PERFORMANCE OF AMP SERIES

Eleven years have passed since the original AMP card was released, but development has continued and improved substantially. To meet the high demand from PC gamers and hardware enthusiasts alike, we developed four levels of performance for AMP'd graphics cards. From the prime model, to the ultimate, there’s an AMP variant that will fulfill just about anyone’s needs:

STRONG - "AMP"

Fast clock speeds right out of the box. Equipped with robust cooling to give more performance.

STRONGER - "AMP MAXX"

Stays cool and packs powerful capabilities while still in a slim, dual-slot configuration. First introduced in GeForce RTX series.

STRONGEST - "AMP Extreme Core"

Flaunting the strongest hardware with near to-the-limit speeds, AMP Extreme Core has incredible power that marginally trails behind the AMP Extreme.

ULTIMATE - "AMP Extreme"

Overclocked to the absolute maximum, graphics cards labeled with AMP Extreme feature binned GPUs which are used to extract every ounce of speed. AMP Extreme graphics cards provide top-of-the-line features for unbeatable performance.

...

However, clock speeds and price are not the only criteria that differentiates AMP'd graphics cards from the others. With great power, comes great features that makes each AMP variant a unique masterpiece:

ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080 Ti AMP Extreme

SPECTRA 2.0 empowers ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080/2080 Ti AMP Extreme Core/AMP Extreme with powerful addressable LEDs (ARGB lighting), allowing for more dynamic lighting that captivates gamers and onlookers. With 13 lighting modes, including animated effects, a wide spectrum is provided for custom colors and individual configuration of lighting zones.

POWERBOOST is a power-controlling chip found only on AMP Extreme Core, AMP MAXX, and AMP Extreme models. Powerboost reduces ripple noise and minimizes power fluctuation to increase longevity. Even when pushed to the limit, it helps maintain smoothness and stability.

Most of the AMP Extreme, AMP Extreme Core, and AMP MAXX graphics cards feature smart fan control. They come embedded with FREEZE technology, which is a “fan stop” feature. The inspired function enables fans to start and stop at their predefined temperature threshold automatically, which reduces noise and wear on the fan system, when the card is sitting idle.

The latest ZOTAC GAMING AMP'd graphics cards feature IceStorm 2.0 - our strongest cooling system yet, which utilizes an improved heatpipe layout and a stronger, thicker aluminum array heatsink for maximum cooling efficiency. Variably configured sized heatpipes maximize heat extraction from the core, while the vast aluminum fin array efficiently disperses heat. Mounted with triple or dual fans that amplifies airflow, temperatures are kept in firm check so performance stays at maximum.

Title: ZOTAC | Mini PCs and GeForce RTX Gaming Graphics Cards | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/page/zotac-gaming-geforce-rtx-20-series
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
GB1801-02X09

NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ delivers the ultimate PC gaming experience. Powered by the new NVIDIA Turing™ GPU architecture and the revolutionary RTX platform, RTX graphics cards bring together real-time ray tracing, artificial intelligence, and programmable shading. This is a whole new way to experience games.

THE STRONGEST

Finely tuned for perfection to extract every ounce of speed. AMP Extreme is the ultimate piece of engineering set to be the strongest in its class out of the box.

STRONG

Tuned for faster and stronger performance, AMP MAXX stays cool and keeps strong in a slim dual-slot configuration.

FROM THE FACTORY

Get guaranteed more speed with AMP, factory overclocked ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX graphics cards right out of the box. More speed, more performance.

ICESTORM 2.0

Our strongest cooling. A larger and thicker aluminum fin stack array in combination with five 8mm copper heat pipes, which four are straight, work in harmony to extract more heat than previous generation designs. *available on select models

STRONGER

The all-new graphics card is also stronger in durability. An additional die-cast metal jacket layer make the all-new graphics card stronger. With full board coverage, it adds an integral structural strengthening and as a plus, additional heat dissipation.

WRAPAROUND PROTECTION

Extending protection of the backside PCB and beyond, our signature metal wraparound backplate wraps around to the front, fusing design and protection into a single fluid union. *available on select models

SPECTRA 2.0

Equipped with more powerful Addressable LEDs, lighting and color are now both more fluid and dynamic. Enable new lighting effects introduced solely for SPECTRA 2.0 hardware. Make the ZOTAC GAMING graphics card yours and personalize it to the theme of your gaming PC with just a few clicks. Easily change the color, brightness, or lighting mode to just your liking. *available on select models

*more new features available on FireStorm utility

FREEZE

Featuring fan stop. An inspired innovation that enables your powerful graphics card to become silent while reducing the wear and tear on the fan system. Greater system stability is achieved with precision temperature gauging and wider temperature tolerance. Fans start and stop at their pre-defined threshold automatically so game on. *available on select models

ACTIVE FAN CONTROL

Introducing Active Fan Control to enable smarter fans. Two individual fan controllers allow users to adjust fan rotations independently and apply increased airflow only to where and when it’s needed, reducing overall noise and increase longevity while still keeping things cool under the hood and performance going strong. It’s all done automatically so there’s nothing you need to do.

FAN 1 35%

FAN 2 82%

NEW FAN DESIGN

Quietly slice through the air, grab and generate wind, direct the flow, and extend the circulation. The all-new fan design performs the multi-stage sweep with each rotation with minimal effort. The multi-stage blades feature blade tips at the outer edge to generate multiple currents and a raised inner with a grooved curved path direct the flow more inwards to allow the airflow to touch and pull away more heat. *available on select models

POWERBOOST

A control chip providing live electrical current regulation and instant electrical deviation responses. POWERBOOST reduces ripple noise, minimizes power fluctuations, and has a high temperature tolerance, resulting in a longer lasting AMPed graphics cards. *available on select models

16+4 POWER PHASES

Spreading the load to 16 power phases means that no one power phase is overworked and building up too much heat. With more distribution of power, experience unparalleled stability operating at peak efficiency. *available on select models

USB TYPE-C

Introducing the new standard connector that will power future Virtual Reality headsets. A single USB Type-C connection will enable future Virtual Reality experiences to be easier to set up, less cumbersome to use, and with less cables dangling about.

...

GeForce RTX™ Gaming GPUs come loaded with next-generation GDDR6 memory, support for DirectX 12 features, and more. This is graphics reinvented.
